caption: The drawing features a single, upright, ornate metal coffee pot with a long, curved spout extending to the left and an arched handle on the right. The body of the coffee pot is conical and decorated with a patterned design that includes a large, central peach-colored fruit with yellow highlights, surrounded by olive-green and brown ornamental shapes, likely leaves. The lower portion of the pot and the base rim are adorned with a repeating yellow and brown motif. The upper part of the pot and the lid are black, with the lid featuring yellow-gold circular and linear patterns. The coffee pot stands alone against a plain, off-white background, and the artist's name, "John Hall," is written in the lower right corner.
title: Toleware Coffee Pot
